import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_3.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
# Each source has schema: ['Wrestler', 'Wins', 'Losses', 'Draws']
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# The target schema has columns for 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016 stats separately.
# Each source table corresponds to one year:
# Source0 -> 2013
# Source1 -> 2014
# Source2 -> 2015
# Source3 -> 2016

# Rename columns in each source to match the target schema for that year
dfs[0] = dfs[0].rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2013 Wins',
    'Losses': '2013 Losses',
    'Draws': '2013 Draws'
})

dfs[1] = dfs[1].rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2014 Wins',
    'Losses': '2014 Losses',
    'Draws': '2014 Draws'
})

dfs[2] = dfs[2].rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2015 Wins',
    'Losses': '2015 Losses',
    'Draws': '2015 Draws'
})

dfs[3] = dfs[3].rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2016 Wins',
    'Losses': '2016 Losses',
    'Draws': '2016 Draws'
})

# Now join all four DataFrames on 'Wrestler' using outer join to keep all wrestlers
# This is because some wrestlers may appear in some years but not others
df_merged = dfs[0]
for df in dfs[1:]:
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df, on='Wrestler', how='outer')

# Fill NaN values with 0 for all numeric columns (wins, losses, draws)
numeric_cols = [col for col in df_merged.columns if col != 'Wrestler']
df_merged[numeric_cols] = df_merged[numeric_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Wrestler',
    '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
    '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
    '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
    '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws'
]

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# Write the final DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Rename columns to match target schema for each year/source
# Source0 -> 2013 columns
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2013 Wins',
    'Losses': '2013 Losses',
    'Draws': '2013 Draws'
})

# Source1 -> 2014 columns
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2014 Wins',
    'Losses': '2014 Losses',
    'Draws': '2014 Draws'
})

# Source2 -> 2015 columns
df2_renamed = df2.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2015 Wins',
    'Losses': '2015 Losses',
    'Draws': '2015 Draws'
})

# Source3 -> 2016 columns
df3_renamed = df3.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2016 Wins',
    'Losses': '2016 Losses',
    'Draws': '2016 Draws'
})

# Join all tables on Wrestler (inner join to keep only wrestlers present in all sources)
df_join_1 = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on='Wrestler', how='inner')
df_join_2 = pd.merge(df_join_1, df2_renamed, on='Wrestler', how='inner')
df_join_all = pd.merge(df_join_2, df3_renamed, on='Wrestler', how='inner')

# Group by Wrestler and sum all numeric columns to aggregate duplicates if any
group_cols = ['Wrestler']
agg_cols = [col for col in df_join_all.columns if col != 'Wrestler']

df_final = df_join_all.groupby(group_cols, as_index=False)[agg_cols].sum()

# Write output to the specified path
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_62/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
